sources.title: Migrate from GPTModel to HybridModel — Megatron Core
sources.snippet: The hybrid model retargets its own checkpoint state dict at the GPT checkpoint's keys during loading, so no second copy is written to disk. This supports both torch_dist checkpoints and Megatron-FSDP fsdp_dtensor checkpoints, including their optimizer state.
